text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests look at how different parts of the system work together. Test-driven development is a method where developers write tests before they write the actual code. This may seem slow at first, but it helps catch problems early. When a project has good tests, developers feel more confident about making changes, because they know the tests will show if something breaks. In short, testing saves time and makes better software.
